segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Option A. The room is very quiet.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Option B. The unit arrived this morning.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Option C. We should investigate further before closing the case.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Our shipment arrived without the packing list.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Option A. I'll request a copy from the supplier.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Option B. The boxes are stacked neatly.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Option C. The shipping route is shorter.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The deadline has been brought forward by two days.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Option A. The calendar is on the wall.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Option B. Two days of training were useful.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Option C. We'll need to adjust our work schedule.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: I'm not sure which manual applies to this model.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Option A. I read it on the train.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Option B. Check the model number on the cover.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Option C. The model is very popular.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Are the spare parts in stock?

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Option A. The stock price rose.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Option B. The parts look similar.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Option C. I'll check with the warehouse.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Have you tested the backup generator?

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Option A. Electricity prices have risen.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Option B. The test is scheduled for tomorrow.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Option C. The generator is heavy.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Is there an extra charge for installation?

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Option A. No, it's included in the purchase price.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Option B. The technician starts at eight.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Option C. The installation takes two hours.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Do you know whether the client approved the design?

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Option A. I'm waiting for their written confirmation.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Option B. The designer uses a tablet.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Option C. The approval stamp is blue.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Can this report be shared with the customer?

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Option A. The customer is waiting downstairs.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Option B. The report contains ten charts.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Option C. Please get the manager's approval first.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Are we still using the old inspection form?

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Option A. The old office is empty.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Option B. A revised version takes effect on Monday.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Option C. The inspection lasted an hour.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Will there be a question-and-answer session?

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Option A. The answer key is on page ten.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Option B. The session was recorded last year.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Option C. Yes, after the main presentation.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Did the courier call before arriving?

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Option A. I only received a text message.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Option B. The caller spoke clearly.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Option C. The arrival hall is crowded.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Is the repair covered by the warranty?

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Option A. The warranty card is green.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Option B. I'll need to check the purchase date.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Option C. The repair shop is nearby.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Do we have enough chairs for the visitors?

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Option A. The chairperson is on leave.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Option B. The visitors came by train.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Option C. We should borrow a few from the next room.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: The boxes from Pine Supplies arrived, but the packing list says twenty cables and I counted only eighteen.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Did you check the small carton underneath?

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Yes. It contains connectors, not cables.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: I'll contact the supplier now. Please take a photo of the items and keep all the packaging.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: The packaging machine stops whenever we run the larger cartons.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Does it work normally with the smaller ones?

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Yes. I recorded both runs and saved the alarm log.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Good. Send those files to me. I'll review them before visiting the line at two this afternoon.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: My flight now arrives at nine at night, after the rental counter closes.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: We can arrange a hotel shuttle instead. Which terminal will you use?

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Terminal One. Will someone be waiting there?

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Yes. The driver will hold a sign with your company name. I'll email the pickup details this afternoon.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Sixteen people have accepted the invitation, but the room only seats twelve.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: The training room seats twenty, although it has no video screen.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: We won't need a screen. Could you reserve it and update the invitation?

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Certainly. I'll also tell reception about the room change.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: I bought this desk lamp online, but the switch doesn't work.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: I'm sorry. We can replace it, or you can request a refund.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: I'd prefer a replacement. Do I have to pay to return this one?

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: No. I'll send a prepaid return label. Your new lamp will ship when the courier scans the returned package.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: I start at the west branch on Monday. Should I report directly to my department?

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Please go to reception at eight forty-five for your temporary badge. Your supervisor will meet you at nine.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Do I need to bring anything?

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Your identification and bank account details. Lunch will be provided during orientation.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: The customer has changed the delivery location from the office to their warehouse.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Has the truck already left?

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Not yet. It leaves in half an hour.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Then update the shipping label and give the driver the warehouse contact number. I'll confirm the change with the customer by email.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The training portal says my password is invalid, even after I reset it.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Are you using your old employee number as the username?

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Yes. Isn't that still correct?

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: We switched to email addresses last week. Try that first. If it still fails, call me and I'll check your account.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: We reserved lunch for twelve, but two visitors are each bringing one colleague.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: I'll increase the order to fourteen. Do they have any dietary requirements?

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: One person needs a vegetarian meal. The others can have the standard menu.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: I'll call the caterer before their ten o'clock deadline.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Our booth is next to the main entrance, but the display units won't arrive until tomorrow.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Can we set up the banner today?

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Yes. The banner and printed brochures are already here.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Then I'll handle those now. Please text me when the display shipment arrives so I can arrange the remaining setup.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: The device stopped working, and I can't find the paper receipt.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Did you order through our website? We can check your purchase history.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Yes, using this email address.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: I found it. You purchased it eight months ago, so the one-year warranty is still valid. We'll arrange a service appointment.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: I finished replacing the gearbox, but I haven't uploaded the service report.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Please include the serial number and photos of the worn gears.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Should I also list the replacement parts?

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Yes. The customer needs the full record before approving the work order. Send me a draft by four.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: The interview candidate asked whether the technical test can be done remotely.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: The first interview can be online, but the practical assessment must take place here.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: I'll explain that. Should I offer the Tuesday or Thursday appointment?

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Thursday. The lab is booked for equipment checks on Tuesday.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Our electricity use dropped last month, even though production increased.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: That may be because of the new lighting controls. They switch off lights in empty areas.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Can we include the figures in the monthly report?

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Yes, but compare use per unit of production as well as total use. That will make the result more meaningful.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: The supplier says our payment hasn't arrived, but finance sent it on Monday.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Did they use the updated bank account?

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: I'm not sure. The supplier changed banks last month.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Ask finance to check the transfer details before sending another payment. We should avoid paying twice.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: We planned the maintenance for Saturday, but the client now needs the line running that day.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Could we move it to Sunday morning?

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The service team is available, but we need approval for weekend access.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: I'll ask the site manager and confirm by three today. Don't change the booking until you hear from me.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: The road to the conference center is closed for a city race tomorrow.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Then the shuttle won't be able to use the usual stop.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: The organizer has arranged a temporary pickup point behind the station.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Let's put that information in the attendee email and add a map so people don't wait at the wrong place.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: I completed the online safety modules, but I still can't download the certificate.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Have you passed the final assessment?

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Yes, my score was eighty-two percent.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Then you only need to complete the feedback form. The download link appears after you submit it.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: The office move is next Friday. Can your team pack the archive boxes by Thursday noon?

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: We can, but some files must stay accessible until Friday morning.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Put those in separate boxes marked priority. The movers will load them last and unload them first.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: That should work. I'll send you the list of priority boxes.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The pressure readings from the morning test don't match the afternoon results.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Were the same test conditions used?

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The room temperature was different, and we used another gauge.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Record both differences in the report. We should compare the setup before deciding that the chamber has a leak.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: I reserved two nights, but my meeting has moved, so I need to stay one extra night.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: The same room is available. The additional night is one hundred twenty dollars, including breakfast.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Please add it. Can you send the updated confirmation to my work email?

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Certainly. I'll keep the original booking reference.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: The update fixed the printing problem, but now the report takes longer to open.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Does that happen with every report?

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Only the files with more than a hundred pages.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Send me one example and the software version number. I'll reproduce the issue before escalating it to the development team.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: More families registered for the open day than we expected.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: We may need another guide for the factory tours.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: I can ask Daniel. He led the tours last year.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Good. Please also remind visitors that photography is allowed only in the lobby, not in the production area.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The installation team arrives at seven tomorrow. Will the loading area be clear?

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Yes. The old equipment will be removed this afternoon.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Great. We also need someone from facilities to confirm the utility connections before work starts.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: I'll ask the facilities engineer to meet your team at the loading area.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Supplier A can deliver in five days, while Supplier B needs two weeks.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Is there a large price difference?

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Supplier A costs ten percent more, but we need the parts next week.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Then use A for this urgent order. For the next order, let's compare quality records as well as price and delivery time.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Could you swap shifts with me next Wednesday? I have a morning appointment.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: I can take your morning shift if you can work my Friday evening shift.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: That works for me. Do we need the supervisor's approval?

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Yes. Submit the shift-change form, and I'll confirm my agreement in the system.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Your quotation lists training as optional. Is installation included?

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Yes, installation and initial testing are included, but travel costs are listed separately.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Could you send a total that includes travel? We need the full amount for approval.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Certainly. I'll revise the quotation today and keep training as a separate option.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: The tracking page says the package was delivered, but reception hasn't seen it.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Did the courier include a photograph?

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Yes. It shows a blue door, but our main entrance is glass.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: That sounds like the building next door. I'll contact their receptionist while you report the delivery error to the courier.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: The beginners' course is full, but we still have places in the evening session.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Is the content the same?

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Yes. Both include six lessons and a practical workshop. Only the times are different.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Then register me for the evening session. Please send the equipment list so I can prepare before the first lesson.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: We received the replacement panels, but three have scratches.

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: Please don't install those. Can you mark the affected serial numbers on the inspection sheet?

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Yes. Should I return the whole shipment?

segments.speaker: p305
segments.text: No, keep the undamaged panels. I'll arrange collection of the three damaged ones after reviewing the photos.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Attention, staff. The elevators in the east wing will be unavailable from seven until ten tomorrow morning for inspection. Please use the west-wing elevators during that period. Deliveries of large items should be scheduled after ten. If you require assistance moving between floors, contact facilities before leaving today.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Hello, Ms. Park. This is Owen from Westlake Printing. The paper you selected for your brochures is temporarily unavailable. We can use a similar recycled paper at the same price, and the delivery date will remain Friday. Please call me before three today to approve the substitution so we can begin printing this afternoon.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Passengers for the Lakeside express service, please note that the eleven twenty departure will leave from platform six instead of platform three. The departure time has not changed. Staff at the information desk can help passengers who need step-free access. Please check that you have all your belongings before boarding.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Welcome to our demonstration of the new handheld inventory scanner. Unlike our previous model, it can store scanned records without a network connection and synchronize them later. It also weighs twenty percent less. After the demonstration, you may try the scanner at the tables on your right. Our product specialists will be there to answer questions about compatibility.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Welcome to the Riverside Design Museum. Today's guided tour begins at the main staircase at two. The tour lasts forty-five minutes and is included in your admission ticket. Our special furniture exhibition closes at four, one hour before the rest of the museum. Photography is permitted without flash, except in the temporary gallery.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Before today's laboratory orientation, please leave food and drinks in the designated area outside. Visitors must remain with their host throughout the tour. This orientation introduces site rules, but it does not authorize you to operate any equipment. At the end, sign the attendance sheet and return your temporary safety glasses to the collection box.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: This is a message for the receiving team at Brookfield Electronics. Your shipment of control panels will arrive tomorrow between nine and eleven. The delivery includes two pallets rather than the one shown on the original notice. Please ensure that someone is available to check the pallet count and sign the delivery record. Call us today if that window is unsuitable.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Beginning next month, employees may submit travel claims through the new staff portal. Paper forms will still be accepted during the first two weeks of the transition. Please upload clear images of all receipts and enter the project code for each trip. A short online demonstration will be held this Thursday, and a recording will be available afterward.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Thank you for choosing Harbor Kitchen for your company lunch. Groups of eight or more may preselect meals from our set menu to reduce waiting time. Final numbers and meal choices must reach us by noon on the previous business day. Vegetarian meals are available on request. Parking is free for two hours when you show a restaurant receipt at the exit.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Thank you for calling Alder Equipment Support. For an existing service case, please have your case number ready before speaking with an agent. If your request concerns a new fault, prepare the model number and a short description of the symptoms. Our weekend team handles urgent production-stopping issues only. Routine maintenance requests can be submitted through the website at any time.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Our customer response time improved this quarter, from an average of eight hours to five. However, repeat visits have increased slightly. For the next quarter, we will focus on collecting better fault information before dispatching engineers. Please use the revised checklist during the initial customer call and attach any logs or photographs to the case record.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Passengers on flight AZ four eighteen to Stonebridge, boarding has been delayed while the ground crew completes an aircraft inspection. We expect to provide another update at five fifteen. Please remain near gate twelve. Passengers with connecting flights should speak to the service agent beside the gate rather than leaving the departure area.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Welcome to the Green Industry Expo. Your badge gives you entry to all exhibits, but workshops require separate advance registration. The energy management workshop is fully booked; places are still available in the afternoon packaging session. Demonstrations begin every hour at the central stage. Please keep the marked delivery lanes clear throughout the event.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: From Monday, the shared printers will require you to scan your staff badge before a print job is released. This change is intended to prevent confidential documents from being left unattended. You can send a document to the queue from any office computer. Uncollected jobs are deleted after twenty-four hours, so please release your printing promptly.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: Thank you for attending today's careers session. The first hour covers customer support roles, followed by a panel discussion with field engineers. Interviews are not being held today, but you may leave your résumé at the recruitment desk. If you are interested in future openings, scan the code on the final slide to join our job-alert mailing list.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: Hello, this is Mina from Clearview Calibration. Your instrument was scheduled for collection tomorrow, but our driver is unavailable. We can collect it on Thursday morning instead, or you may send it to us using our prepaid label. Please let us know which option you prefer. The quoted five-day turnaround starts when the instrument reaches our laboratory.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: Good evening, guests. Due to maintenance, breakfast will be served in the Garden Room tomorrow rather than the usual restaurant. Service hours remain six thirty to ten. Guests checking out before six thirty may request a takeaway breakfast at reception before nine tonight. The hotel's other dining services are unaffected.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: Next week we will introduce a digital visitor registration system. Hosts should enter visitor names and expected arrival times at least one business day in advance. Visitors will receive a confirmation email containing directions and entry requirements. Please do not include sensitive project details in the visitor name field. A guide to the new process is available on the intranet.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: During Friday's stock count, the warehouse will stop dispatching orders at two in the afternoon. Orders approved before eleven will be prepared for same-day dispatch. Later orders will leave on Monday. Emergency service parts are exempt from this arrangement; contact the warehouse supervisor directly if a customer has a production-stopping issue.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: You have reached the membership office of the Regional Business Association. To renew an existing membership, press one. For upcoming events, press two. To speak with an adviser about joining, remain on the line. Please note that our office will close at noon this Friday for staff training, but online renewals will remain available.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: Our review found that most rejected shipments had incomplete labels rather than damaged products. Starting today, the packing team must use the revised label checklist before sealing each carton. Supervisors will sample completed cartons at the end of each shift. We will review the rejection rate again in four weeks to see whether the change has helped.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: Welcome aboard the island ferry. The crossing takes approximately fifty minutes. During the trip, please remain inside the marked passenger areas and keep bags clear of the aisles. The return ferry leaves at four thirty, not five as shown in the older printed guide. Today's correct timetable is displayed beside the ticket office on the island.

segments.speaker: p302
segments.text: This is a reminder for participants in Saturday's technical writing workshop. Please bring a short, anonymized example of a service report you have written. Remove customer names and confidential information before sharing it. Laptops are optional, since printed worksheets will be supplied. The workshop begins at nine, with registration from eight thirty in Room Four.

segments.speaker: p374
segments.text: The south parking lot will reopen on Monday after resurfacing. Spaces nearest the main door are reserved for accessible parking and must be kept clear for authorized users. Staff with monthly permits may continue using the north lot until the end of the month at no extra charge. A map showing the new pedestrian route is posted on the staff portal.

segments.speaker: p294
segments.text: We will upgrade the order portal between midnight and three on Sunday morning. During that period, you may view existing orders, but you will not be able to submit new ones. Draft orders will be saved automatically. If you need to place an urgent order during the upgrade, call the number on your account page and quote your customer reference.

segments.speaker: p225
segments.text: This notice concerns travel adapters with model code T eighty sold between April and June. A small number may have an internal fault. Stop using affected adapters and visit our support page to check the serial number. Eligible units will be replaced free of charge, even without a receipt. Other models are not included in this notice.

segments.speaker: p317
segments.text: Our outdoor networking reception has moved indoors because of the weather forecast. It will take place in the Maple Hall, beside the main auditorium, at the original time of six. Your conference badge is sufficient for entry. The live music has been canceled, but refreshments and the welcome remarks will continue as planned.

segments.speaker: p326
segments.text: Before closing a support case, please confirm that the customer has tested the agreed solution. A technician's successful test alone is not sufficient if the customer's original symptoms have not been checked. Record the test conditions and the customer's response in the case notes. Cases awaiting confirmation should remain open and be reviewed at the next daily briefing.

segments.speaker: p334
segments.text: The public library's business research room will open on Wednesday. It offers access to trade directories and industry databases, with staff assistance from ten until four. Computer sessions can be booked for up to two hours. Printing is charged separately, but use of the databases is free for registered library members. An introductory tour will be held at eleven on opening day.

segments.speaker: p226
segments.text: This month our service team completed ninety planned visits and twelve urgent callouts. Customer feedback highlighted clear explanations as our main strength. However, several customers requested more accurate arrival estimates. Starting Monday, dispatchers will send an updated time window when an engineer leaves the previous site. Please make sure your visit status is current in the scheduling system.
